purpose: Prevent DWG CIRCLE and ARC output from silently serializing invalid nonpositive or non-finite radii.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: ARC and CIRCLE encode radius as BD group 40. Autodesk AcDbArc::setRadius and AcDbCircle::setRadius references require radius greater than zero and return invalid input otherwise.

implementation.behavior: DWG ARC and CIRCLE encoders reject non-finite and nonpositive radii before creating staged bodies or publishing record state. This matches existing DXF writer admission.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; tolerant DWG parsing behavior is unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Every refused write preserves a pre-existing destination. The corrected profile then succeeds using the same dwgRW writer instance and reads back with the exact radius and zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All inputs are authored by the test in scratch storage; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: The generated control proves invalid-input refusal, destination preservation, correction/retry, and readback for these writer profiles; it does not establish producer prevalence or native consumer rendering.
This slice does not close the broader P6 per-version geometry/no-loss audit.
supportClaimEffect: Closes one bounded DWG writer admission gap; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
